children: FedEx has ordered 2,000 all-electric trucks from Harbinger for upwards of $300 million.

Harbinger said Wednesday that it believes FedEx's order is among the largest binding orders for electric medium or heavy-duty trucks in history. It plans to deliver the vehicles by the end of next year.
Harbinger has previously deployed its vehicles in FedEx's network, and FedEx co-led the company's $160 million Series C funding round last year.
"FedEx is demonstrating that the business case for incorporating electric vehicles into real-world fleet operations at scale makes sense," Harbinger Chief Executive John Harris said.

The company said it estimates that the 2,000 vehicles in a North American fleet can generate around $40 million in annual savings on fuel, representing potential savings of $800 million given the typical vehicle life of 20 years.
